name: Kuala Lumpur
summary: The Petronas Towers and KL Tower, Chinatown and Jalan Alor's hawker stalls, the National Mosque and Islamic Arts Museum, and the Batu Caves steps just outside the city.

tips.title: Fill in the MDAC before you fly
tips.body: Travellers entering Malaysia must submit a Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) before travel, and airlines may ask for it at check-in. Use only the official site, imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main. The Malaysian Immigration website lists who is exempt.

tips.title: 90-day visa-free stay for UK visitors
tips.body: British tourists are normally allowed 90 days on arrival. Other nationalities should check their own allowance. Work, study or longer stays need a visa arranged before travel.

tips.title: Six months' passport validity
tips.body: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after your arrival date, undamaged and with no missing pages.

tips.title: Do not overstay
tips.body: Even a short overstay can lead to a fine, detention, deportation at your own cost or a ban on returning. Check the stay granted on your entry record.

tips.title: Possible drug test on arrival
tips.body: Authorities may require a urine test on arrival. You can be penalised even if the drug was taken in a country where it is legal.

tips.title: Declare cash of US$10,000 or more
tips.body: You must declare cash or travellers' cheques worth US$10,000 or more. Taking ringgit worth US$10,000 or more into or out of Malaysia needs prior approval.

tips.title: Yellow fever certificate if arriving from a risk country
tips.body: You need a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk. This does not apply to direct flights from most of Europe or North America.

places.name: PETRONAS Twin Towers
places.blurb: 88-storey twin towers with a Skybridge on levels 41-42 and an observation deck on level 86.
places.tip: The skybridge and observation deck are closed on Mondays. Book a time slot ahead.

places.name: KL Tower
places.blurb: 421 m telecom tower with an observation deck and the open-air Sky Deck.

places.name: KL Forest Eco Park
places.blurb: Rainforest reserve below KL Tower with a canopy walkway.

places.name: KLCC Park
places.blurb: Landscaped park below the Petronas Towers with the Lake Symphony fountain.

places.name: Heli Lounge Bar
places.blurb: Bar on a rooftop helipad with open skyline views.

places.name: Merdeka Square
places.blurb: Colonial-era square where independence was declared in 1957, facing the Sultan Abdul Samad Building.

places.name: Perdana Botanical Gardens
places.blurb: KL's large central park with themed gardens near the National Monument.

places.name: National Museum
places.blurb: Malaysia's national history museum in a Malay-palace-style building.

places.name: Petaling Street
places.blurb: Covered market street at the heart of KL's Chinatown.

places.name: Jalan Alor
places.blurb: Street of open-air food stalls and restaurants, busiest at night.

places.name: Islamic Arts Museum Malaysia
places.blurb: Large museum of Islamic decorative arts with over 7,000 artefacts.

places.name: National Mosque
places.blurb: Modernist national mosque from 1965 with a folded star-shaped roof.
places.tip: Closed to visitors at prayer times. Robes are lent at the door.

places.name: Guan Di Temple
